name: flashinfer_073_encoder_norm_kv_projection_baseline
author: flashinfer
description: FlashInfer rmsnorm + torch linear baseline for L1_073

sources.content:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import flashinfer.norm


@torch.no_grad()
def run(encoder_hidden_states, norm_weight, k_proj_weight, v_proj_weight, eps):
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = encoder_hidden_states.shape
    num_kv_heads = 2
    head_dim = 64

    # RMSNorm via FlashInfer (needs 2D input)
    x_flat = encoder_hidden_states.reshape(-1, hidden_size).contiguous()
    normalized = flashinfer.norm.rmsnorm(x_flat, norm_weight, eps)
    normalized = normalized.reshape(batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

    # K/V projections
    keys_flat = F.linear(normalized, k_proj_weight)
    values_flat = F.linear(normalized, v_proj_weight)

    keys = keys_flat.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
    values = values_flat.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_kv_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2).contiguous()

    return keys, values
